title: Tenma Saki — Visibly & Audibly Asleep〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: As the Leaves Change Once More

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Saki! Shiho!
Let's have lunch together☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That was fast...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Haha.
Right after the bell rang.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe♪ I haven't been able to sit still at all. There's so much I wanna talk about!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Those snacks you brought back for me from your trip were really yummy☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? That's great to hear!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho and I sampled a lot of different ones in order to figure out what to get you♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, since we were there, we wanted to get you something good.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really...?!
Thank you both so much for putting so much thought into my gift♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. We had so much fun during our trip that we wanted you to get at least a small taste of it, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Does that mean Tsukasa and Hinomori also had a super duper fun and exciting time?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, they also really enjoyed themselves!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, we took a bunch of pictures!
Here, have a look♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You have pictures?! Lemme see!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We collected the very best ones to make a mini album!
Here, take a look!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow!
You guys are all smiling and look like you're having such a wonderhoy time☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right? I think this is my favorite one♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho and Hinomori are picking grapes together in this one!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right!
As it turns out, Shizuku's really good at that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I love this one. The way she's showing Shiho what to do makes them feel like real sisters.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, feel like...? We are real sisters.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What about this one...? Oh, it's Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That was when Tsukasa found what he believed were the vineyard's “number-one” grapes!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Number-one grapes?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, he thought so because they were big, shiny and full of color!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow☆ So, they're like the king of grapes.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, he just claimed that they were the number-one grapes.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, these look like our leaf-viewing photos...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow...!
This mountain's so pretty! It's completely red...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And everything's all sparkly somehow!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It started raining right when we got there.
We were all a little disappointed at first...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But then we noticed how the raindrops made the leaves sparkle and glisten. Then, it started to feel like a rare and special moment!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Talk about super special luck☆
Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I'm seeing lots of pictures with Tsukasa, Shiho and Hinomori...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But not many that include you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
I took all these on my phone...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, Saki, you always do this.
Luckily, I took some myself.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Here, take a look...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow☆ So many pictures of Saki!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku was the one who started taking these.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Unfortunately, only a few of hers turned out well. Most of them turned out blurry, and that's if her finger didn't cover up part of the lens.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you! I love you so much!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, calm down. We won't be able to see unless you let go.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa's feeding Saki some grapes in this one! Open wide...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. I couldn't eat any on my own because I was carrying a bunch of grapes in each hand!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I really like this one.
When you lined up all those leaves next to each other, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa!
The way you lined up these leaves on these rocks makes it look like a little store!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ I had so much fun picking them up because they came in so many pretty colors.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Hehe. I sorta forgot about that.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're smiling so much in all these pictures, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You look like you're having the best time of your life! Now I'm feeling all warm and fuzzy inside♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...! Thanks for taking these, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Can I see what else you took?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure.
